channels.name: Niro Studio
channels.description: Light general-knowledge and sports quizzes written by the NiroLearn team, made for the minutes between study sessions or for a game with friends in a room.

channels.name: Atlas Trail

channels.name: Curiosity Lab
channels.description: Science and animals for people who like to ask why: the human body, space, chemistry, physics and the wonders of living things.
